import Lean

/-!
Planted by the trust self-test, plant V2-E3: `@[extern]` data attached through
the attribute API, so that no source token spells the attribute. Only the
environment pass of the gate can see it.
-/

def plantedExternTarget : Nat := 0

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftCoreM do
  match Lean.externAttr.setParam (← Lean.getEnv) `plantedExternTarget
      { entries := [Lean.ExternEntry.adhoc `all] } with
  | .ok environment => Lean.setEnv environment
  | .error message => throwError message
